what: Yearly prices at 10,000 credits went up: Core from $11 to $12, Pro from $20 to $21 and Teams from $36 to $38 a month. Monthly billing stayed at $16, $28 and $51. The Pro and Teams credit tiers now go up to 8,000,000 credits a month.
Added the Tell 1 (Beta) model at $0.035 a minute, and $0.011 a message for chat agents.
